title: add rbac policy dependency graph and idempotent terraform apply
author: Ada Kim
description: This PR introduces two coordinated pieces of automation aimed at making Private installs and upgrades safer and fully idempotent: 1) an RBAC policy dependency graph and lightweight verifier that computes ordering and detects missing bootstrap permissions before any mutation; 2) Terraform idempotency and state-lock heuristics for tenant-scoped resource seeds so repeated apply/upgrade runs are safe in air-gapped/on‑prem environments. Motivation: we've seen intermittent upgrade failures where Helm hooks and Terraform seed ordering conflicted, causing partial RBAC seeds and failed rollbacks during Private upgrades. The verifier (rbac-dep-check) can run as a preflight step in the installer and as a CI check; it returns a deterministic ordering, highlights implicit policy edges (e.g. rolebinding->crd-watch needs), and emits a minimal dry-run patch plan that Helm/Terraform can use. The Terraform changes add a lockfile pattern and a two-phase apply where seed Terraform modules write a small idempotency marker into the customer VPC (ConfigMap or tag) and the installer validates that marker before attempting destructive updates. Key properties: - Non-destructive: verifier never mutates live resources during checks unless run with --apply. - Deterministic order: the dep graph flattens policy bundles into an ordered sequence for Helm pre-upgrade hooks or for the Terraform seed step. - Recoverable upgrades: when apply fails mid-way, the idempotency markers let the installer resume or safely rollback to last known good state. This PR includes unit tests for the graph algorithm, integration tests for the Terraform marker behavior against kind clusters and a mocked KMS for encrypted markers, and a small CLI shim that the existing installer calls in the preflight hook. Checklist: - [x] Implement dependency graph builder and JSON export - [x] Add rbac-dep-check CLI and installer integration - [x] Add Terraform marker module and lockfile generation - [x] Helm hook adjustments for pre-upgrade dry-run using verifier ordering - [x] Unit & integration tests - [x] Docs: private-installer/README update and runbook notes on resume/rollback How this differs from previous work: instead of shipping a one-off bootstrap script we formalize policy dependencies and make the terraform seed idempotent via a marker + lockfile pattern that is safe in air-gapped installs and compatible with existing tenant rotation flows. Followups: tie the verifier output into the console rollout UI and expose the graph as a small SVG in upgrade logs.
commits_summary: 7 commits: add dep graph library; implement rbac-dep-check CLI; terraform marker module + tests; helm hook changes; installer preflight integration; docs; fix tests and CI flakiness
review_comments: Jamal Thompson: Nice work overall. Please make the marker key rotation-friendly and ensure the marker uses customer KMS when available.
Ada Kim: Reply: marker supports optional KMS encryption via installer flag --marker-kms-key and falls back to hashed-tag in air-gapped mode. Added integration tests for both.
Priya Reddy: Can the verifier detect circular dependencies across bundles? If so we should include guidance in the runbook.
Ada Kim: Reply: yes, verifier emits cycles and fails fast with a suggested break point and a link to the runbook section added in this PR.
Ellen Zhou: CI flake on integration test — looks like timing for the mocked KMS. Add retries.
Ada Kim: Reply: increased retries and added backoff; re-ran CI.
Release manager (internal): Please include short release notes and rollback steps.
Ada Kim: Added release-notes.md and a simple rollback script (scripts/resume_rollout.sh) referenced in the PR.
Security: ensure marker doesn't include PII. Confirmed marker contains only hashed installation id and a timestamp.
Ada Kim: Confirmed and added unit test verifying sanitized marker payloads.
QA: Verified upgrade/resume flow on a 3-node on-prem-like cluster; minor timing adjustments to Helm hook sleep window.
release_notes: Idempotent RBAC seeding and preflight dependency checks for Private installer. Adds rbac-dep-check verifier and Terraform marker module to improve upgrade reliability and allow safe resume/rollback in on-prem installs.
